column1: # Diet coverage (staging checkpoint 5, Q5, Q7, Q19): the severe types measured on a judged sample. Food rows are foods of the frozen USDA catalog (gate-catalog.tsv), seven a category and 25 more from the categories that carry the class, drawn by md5 of the id; each is read by its name and its USDA description as the gate reads them. Line rows are constructed recipe lines. Recipe rows (staging checkpoint 6, cleanup2/ck11-diet-coverage) are the public-domain cookbook recipes of the checkpoint's judged sample: text is the lines joined by " ;; ", description the food a judged hold rests on, category the book title.

# expect: hit (the type must flag it) or clear (it must not). status ok with source rule:diet-coverage is rule-given by the category entry (Fish, Crustaceans, Mollusks, Nuts, the dairy and egg entries of category 1); rule:diet-vocabulary by a cited label name or standard; agent rows were judged by the builder (agent-ck10-diet-coverage) from what the food is, not from the gate.
# The bar (GoldenDietCoverageTests): no hit row missed, and under 5 % of each type's clear rows flagged.
